essence: Therefore, one who feeds a maiden effectively feeds all three worlds.
Therefore, the devotion-minded practitioner attains all fullness.
Therefore, even the ill-fated succeed merely by performing it.
Therefore, the practitioner vows either to accomplish the mantra or to abandon the body.
Therefore, one should worship fully with offerings and mental acts.
